issues.message: The detached pronoun هُمْ is described as the explicit subject of the clause, but in ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ it is the topic/nominal subject of the clause whose predicate is the verbal sentence يُرَآءُونَ. The verb itself carries its grammatical subject in the attached واو الجماعة of ـونَ.
issues.requiredAction: Rewrite the occurrence role and all linked explanations so هُمْ is identified as the topic/nominal subject, and distinguish it from the attached plural subject marker in يُرَآءُونَ.

evidence.draftText: Explicit subject of the clause whose verb is يُرَآءُونَ.
evidence.correctRelationship: هُمْ is a detached third-person masculine-plural pronoun functioning as the topic/nominal subject; يُرَآءُونَ is the predicate verbal sentence and its واو الجماعة supplies the verb's subject.
